data.narrative:
Terraform Industries is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Casey Handmer that has raised $26M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a frontier-tech sector comprised of one public comparable (ticker: LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised ($26M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier associated with Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $52M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables; while eight climate and energy peers exist in the broader dataset, none met the threshold of three or more same-stage or adjacent-stage companies at similar valuation tiers needed for reliable median benchmarking.

The triangulated valuation range is $44M to $60M, with a median point of $52M. This range reflects the single applicable methodology and carries material uncertainty regarding comparable company selection. The thinness of the same-stage peer set in the climate and energy sector is a primary constraint; any forward valuation should be revisited as additional transaction data emerges from the frontier-tech market.
